behavior.arguments: esi low 32 bits compared against 1; edi low 32 bits compared against 4; no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: no branches inside the window; two sete results ANDed, then 9 minus that bit

caller_argument_setup.first_call_site: 0x5154497 preceded by xor %esi,%esi at 0x5154482, so esi = 0, first condition false, call returns 9 regardless of edi
caller_argument_setup.second_call_site: 0x5154726 immediately preceded by mov $0x1,%esi and mov $0x4,%edi, so both conditions hold, call returns 8

behavior.low32_note: comparisons are 32-bit (cmp $imm,%esi / cmp $imm,%edi); rsi = 0x100000001 has low 32 bits 1 and satisfies the first condition; rdi = 0x100000004 satisfies the second
behavior.output_shape: rax is fully determined (mov $0x9,%eax zeroes upper bits): 9 or 8, then ret

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: no relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend
